title.value: TopiOCQA: Open-domain Conversational Question Answering with Topic Switching
title.justification: The paper introduces a new dataset called TopiOCQA, focusing on open-domain question answering with topic switching.
title.quote: We introduce T OPI OCQA (pronounced Tapioca), an open-domain conversational dataset with topic switches based on Wikipedia.

extractions.description: The paper presents TopiOCQA, a new open-domain conversational question answering dataset designed to accommodate topic switching, based on the Wikipedia corpus. The dataset contains 3,920 conversations involving topical changes and emphasizes information-seeking dialogues where the reference text is not provided. The dataset aims to advance research in conversational models requiring efficient retrieval across multiple topics. Baseline evaluations indicate the challenge posed by the dataset, with models like Fusion-in-Decoder achieving an F1 score of 55.8 against human performance.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on developing a conversational question answering dataset, which does not directly address any specific theme related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
